articles.title_en: Price risk and small farmer maize storage in Sub‐Saharan Africa: New insights into a long‐standing puzzle
articles.title_cn: 价格风险与撒哈拉以南非洲小农玉米储存：对一个长期谜题的新见解
articles.abstract_en: Maize prices fluctuate across seasons in rural markets in many low income countries, and agricultural households struggle to sell their grain at an optimal time. We provide new insight into a persistent puzzle: small farmers in low‐income countries tend to sell their maize at harvest, when prices are low, rather than storing and waiting until prices increase later in the year. Our descriptive analysis uses 20 years of data from 1038 retail markets in 30 African countries to demonstrate that the lean season price (the “high price” season) fails to rise above the harvest season price (the “low price” season) 16.3% of the time on average in countries with a single maize season and between 15.9% and 24.9% on average in countries with two maize seasons. On the basis of that stylized fact, we propose that aversion to these negative returns may contribute to farmers' decisions to opt out of storage at harvest. Using a smaller dataset of 425 retail markets in 10 countries with a single maize season, we show that even moderately risk averse farmers would opt out of storage in 15.3% of market years. Farmers cannot always predict returns to storage and output price risk may dissuade farmers from storing maize for the purpose of future sales, despite credit access. Our results indicate that other mechanisms, such as forward contracts or multiyear credit, may be necessary to mitigate downside price risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入国家的农村市场，玉米价格随季节波动，农业家庭难以在最佳时间出售其谷物。我们对一个长期存在的谜题提供了新的见解：低收入国家的小农倾向于在收获时出售玉米，此时价格较低，而不是储存并等待价格在年内晚些时候上涨。我们的描述性分析使用了来自30个非洲国家1038个零售市场的20年数据，表明在单季玉米国家，淡季价格（“高价格”季节）平均有16.3%的时间未能超过收获季节价格（“低价格”季节），而在双季玉米国家，这一比例平均在15.9%至24.9%之间。基于这一典型事实，我们提出对这些负收益的厌恶可能促使农民在收获时选择不储存。使用来自10个单季玉米国家425个零售市场的较小数据集，我们表明即使是中度风险厌恶的农民也会在15.3%的市场年份中选择不储存。农民不能总是预测储存收益，产出价格风险可能阻止农民为未来销售而储存玉米，尽管有信贷渠道。我们的结果表明，其他机制，如远期合约或多年度信贷，可能对缓解下行价格风险是必要的。

articles.title_en: The impact of no‐till on agricultural land values in the United States Midwest
articles.title_cn: 免耕对美国中西部农业土地价值的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of no‐till practice on agricultural land values in the United States (US) Midwest. Two county‐level panel data sets—the agricultural census farmland value data and the Iowa Farmland Values Survey data—are separately merged with a novel satellite‐based data set on no‐till adoption rates to achieve the study objective. Based on linear fixed effect econometric models, recently developed “external‐instrument‐free” estimation procedures, and a number of robustness checks, we find that increasing no‐till adoption rates has a statistically significant positive effect on agricultural land values at the county level. Results from the empirical analysis support the notion that economic and environmental benefits from adopting soil conservation practices, such as no‐till, are likely capitalized into higher farmland values.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了免耕实践对美国中西部农业土地价值的影响。为实现研究目标，我们将两个县级面板数据集——农业普查农田价值数据和爱荷华州农田价值调查数据——分别与一个基于卫星的新型免耕采用率数据集进行合并。基于线性固定效应计量经济模型、近期开发的“无外部工具”估计程序以及一系列稳健性检验，我们发现免耕采用率的提高对县级农业土地价值具有统计上显著的正向影响。实证分析结果支持了这样一种观点，即采用土壤保护实践（如免耕）所带来的经济和环境效益很可能资本化为更高的农田价值。

articles.title_en: More competitive than you think? Pricing and location of processing firms in agricultural markets
articles.title_cn: 比你想象的更具竞争性？农产品市场中加工企业的定价与选址
articles.abstract_en: The spatial distribution of production is a defining characteristic of agriculture, and the location choice in geographic space and the spatial pricing policies adopted by agricultural processing/packing firms are key determinants of the competitiveness and efficiency of agricultural product procurement markets. Spatially distributed buying firms in the presence of costly transportation of farm products creates natural oligopsony procurement markets. Although several studies have contributed to our understanding of price and output determination and the distribution of welfare in these markets, all are limited in that they address buying firms' locations or their choices of spatial pricing strategy in isolation, holding the other factor fixed, even though both would be chosen jointly in reality to comprise a firm's product‐procurement strategy. Here we overcome this limitation by using computational methods (including genetic algorithms) to study duopsony firms' joint choices of location and pricing policy. Our results differ considerably from those presented in prior literature. In general, we find that, when buyers have the flexibility to jointly choose their locations and pricing strategies, market outcomes are much more competitive and locations more efficient in terms of cost minimization than has been predicted by prior studies viewing location choice or pricing strategy in isolation.
articles.abstract_cn: 生产的空间分布是农业的一个决定性特征，地理空间中的选址选择以及农业加工/包装企业采用的空间定价政策是决定农产品采购市场竞争力和效率的关键因素。在农产品运输成本高昂的情况下，空间分布的收购企业形成了自然的寡头买方垄断采购市场。尽管已有若干研究增进了我们对这些市场中价格和产量决定以及福利分配的理解，但这些研究均存在局限性，即它们孤立地处理收购企业的选址或其空间定价策略的选择，而将另一因素视为固定，尽管在现实中两者会被联合选择以构成企业的产品采购策略。在此，我们通过使用计算方法（包括遗传算法）来研究双寡头买方垄断企业在选址和定价政策上的联合选择，从而克服了这一局限性。我们的结果与先前文献中呈现的结果有显著不同。总体而言，我们发现，当买方具有灵活性地联合选择其选址和定价策略时，市场结果比先前研究孤立地看待选址选择或定价策略所预测的更具竞争性，且选址在成本最小化方面更为高效。

articles.title_en: Input subsidies, credit constraints, and expectations of future transfers: Evidence from Haiti
articles.title_cn: 投入补贴、信贷约束与未来转移预期：来自海地的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of a subsidy program in Haiti that provided smallholders subsidies for inputs (rice seeds, fertilizer, pesticides, and specific labor tasks) using a randomized control trial. The program led to lower input use and lower yields in the year subsidies were received, and the decline in input use and yields persisted through the following year. Using data from a complementary information intervention in which randomly selected farmers were provided clarification regarding their future receipt of vouchers, we find evidence suggesting that incorrect expectations of future transfers partially explain the disappointing outcomes. In addition, instead of increasing input use, the subsidies seem to have led farmers to pay off their loans and take fewer new ones. In complex post‐emergency environments such as the one in which this program took place, input subsidies may need to be avoided, as they require considerable information to optimally design and careful coordination by many actors to achieve the expected gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察了海地一个为小农户提供投入品（稻种、化肥、农药及特定劳动任务）补贴的项目效果。该项目在获得补贴的当年导致投入品使用量和产量下降，且这种下降持续到了次年。利用一项补充信息干预的数据（该干预中，随机选取的农户获得了关于未来代金券领取情况的澄清），我们发现有证据表明，对未来转移的错误预期部分解释了这些令人失望的结果。此外，补贴似乎并未增加投入品使用，反而促使农户偿还贷款并减少新贷款。在诸如本项目所处的复杂灾后环境中，可能应避免使用投入补贴，因为其最优设计需要大量信息，且需多方协调才能实现预期收益。

articles.title_en: Concern for animals, other farmers, or oneself? Assessing farmers' support for a policy to improve animal welfare
articles.title_cn: 关心动物、其他农民还是自己？评估农民对改善动物福利政策的支持
articles.abstract_en: Public acceptance of farming practices relating to animal welfare is becoming increasingly important for dairy farmers. In this study, we assess dairy farmers' willingness to pay to support a policy aimed at improving calf welfare and link this to farmers' social preferences. We conceptualize the farmer's decision into private reasons and motivations to improve animal welfare or industry reputation. Our data come from a survey with over 400 Irish dairy farmers that included an experimental component. Specifically, we utilized a contingent valuation referendum method to elicit farmers' willingness to pay. We also used a financially incentivized social value orientation scale based on competitive, individualistic, prosocial, and altruistic preferences. Our findings indicate that most farmers are supportive of a policy scheme to improve animal welfare, and higher social value orientation (i.e. more altruistic preferences) is positively associated with higher willingness to pay. More detailed analysis suggests that industry concern is associated with more altruistic preferences but not concern for animal welfare. Our findings have important policy implications as we show that the majority of farmers are willing to financially support the implementation of a policy that can help to prevent public bads.
articles.abstract_cn: 公众对与动物福利相关的农业实践的接受度对奶牛养殖者变得越来越重要。在本研究中，我们评估了奶牛养殖者为支持旨在改善犊牛福利的政策而愿意支付的金额，并将其与农民的社会偏好联系起来。我们将农民的决定概念化为私人原因以及改善动物福利或行业声誉的动机。我们的数据来自一项包含实验部分的调查，涉及超过400名爱尔兰奶牛养殖者。具体来说，我们采用了条件价值评估公投方法来引出农民的支付意愿。我们还使用了基于竞争、个人主义、亲社会和他主义偏好的经济激励社会价值取向量表。我们的研究结果表明，大多数农民支持改善动物福利的政策方案，且更高的社会价值取向（即更利他的偏好）与更高的支付意愿正相关。更详细的分析表明，行业关注与更利他的偏好相关，但与动物福利关注无关。我们的发现具有重要的政策意义，因为我们表明大多数农民愿意在财务上支持实施有助于防止公共危害的政策。

articles.title_en: Can cash incentives modify groundwater pumping behaviors? Evidence from an experiment in Punjab
articles.title_cn: 现金激励能否改变地下水抽取行为？来自旁遮普省一项实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: As groundwater levels steadily decline in India, authorities are concerned about reducing extraction for irrigation purposes without jeopardizing food security. Very low or zero prices for electricity and water in agriculture is partly responsible for overextraction, but charging higher prices is politically not feasible. In this study, we describe the results of a pilot scheme implemented in Punjab, India, where farmers who enrolled were allocated a monthly entitlement of electricity units and compensated for unused electricity. Eight hours of uninterrupted daytime electricity supply were also provided under the scheme instead of the usual mix of daytime and night‐time supply. Analyzing data from a cross‐sectional farm household survey and instrumenting for enrollment, we find that self‐reported hours of irrigation for enrolled farmers were significantly lower than for non‐enrolled ones, with no impact on rice yields. We also find a reduction in monthly electricity consumption at electricity‐feeder level due to the pilot scheme using the synthetic control method. Our results suggest that the combination of daytime electricity provision and cash incentives for unused electricity has the potential to incentivize farmers to reduce electricity consumption and irrigation hours by at least 7.5% and up to 30% without impacting paddy yields.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着印度地下水位的持续下降，当局关注在不危及粮食安全的情况下减少农业灌溉用水抽取。农业用电和用水价格极低或为零，部分导致了过度抽取，但提高价格在政治上不可行。在本研究中，我们描述了在印度旁遮普省实施的一项试点计划的结果，参与该计划的农民每月获得一定额度的电力配额，并为未使用的电力获得补偿。该计划还提供每天八小时不间断的白天电力供应，而非通常的白天和夜间混合供应。通过分析横截面农户调查数据并对参与情况进行工具变量处理，我们发现参与计划的农民自我报告的灌溉小时数显著低于未参与农民，且对水稻产量没有影响。我们还使用合成控制法发现，试点计划在电力馈线层面减少了月度电力消耗。我们的结果表明，白天电力供应与未使用电力现金激励的结合，有潜力激励农民减少电力消耗和灌溉小时数，至少减少7.5%，最多减少30%，且不影响水稻产量。

articles.title_en: Systemic risk, relative subsidy rates, and area yield insurance choice
articles.title_cn: 系统性风险、相对补贴率与区域产量保险选择
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the nature of crop yield systemic risk and its implications for farmers' area yield insurance choices. A theory‐grounded, normalized measure of systemic risk, R 2 , is developed and made amenable to empirical analysis through the logit link. The measure is estimated on a large‐scale, unit‐level corn yield dataset. We find that systemic risk explains less than half of total unit yield variability on average, suggesting that the risk management effectiveness of area yield insurance is low. By relating natural resource endowments with systemic risk, we find that more excessive heat and drought events lead to larger while more excessive precipitation events lead to smaller systemic risk. We then study whether current area yield insurance subsidy rates provide farmers with sufficient subsidy transfers to compensate for the uncovered risk exposure associated with area yield insurance. A new concept, the threshold relative area subsidy rate (TRASR), quantifies a lower bound on the ratio of area yield insurance subsidy rate over individual yield insurance subsidy rate below which risk‐averse farmers should always prefer individual yield insurance to area yield insurance. The calibrated TRASR values indicate that current area yield insurance subsidy rates discourage farmers from choosing area yield insurance over individual yield insurance, especially at low area yield insurance coverage levels. We also find that TRASR is positively correlated with systemic risk at the unit‐level of analysis, suggesting that farmers who like area yield insurance's risk management features will dislike its transfer implications and vice versa.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了作物产量系统性风险的性质及其对农户区域产量保险选择的影响。我们开发了一种基于理论的、规范化的系统性风险度量R 2，并通过logit链接使其适用于实证分析。该度量在一个大规模、单位级别的玉米产量数据集上进行了估计。我们发现，系统性风险平均解释了总单位产量变异性的一半以下，表明区域产量保险的风险管理有效性较低。通过将自然资源禀赋与系统性风险联系起来，我们发现过多的炎热和干旱事件导致系统性风险增大，而过多的降水事件导致系统性风险减小。然后，我们研究了当前区域产量保险补贴率是否为农户提供了足够的补贴转移，以补偿与区域产量保险相关的未覆盖风险暴露。一个新概念——阈值相对区域补贴率（TRASR）——量化了区域产量保险补贴率与个人产量保险补贴率之比的下限，低于该下限，风险厌恶的农户应始终偏好个人产量保险而非区域产量保险。校准后的TRASR值表明，当前区域产量保险补贴率阻碍了农户选择区域产量保险而非个人产量保险，尤其是在区域产量保险覆盖率较低的情况下。我们还发现，在单位层面的分析中，TRASR与系统性风险呈正相关，这表明喜欢区域产量保险风险管理特征的农户将不喜欢其转移含义，反之亦然。

articles.title_en: Upside risk, consumption value, and market returns to food safety
articles.title_cn: 上行风险、消费价值与食品安全的市场回报
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of a modest food safety premium on semisubsistence farmers' investment in a food safety technology. We demonstrate theoretically that in the face of production uncertainty, a market incentive below the marginal production cost of achieving the safety standard can increase food safety investment among farmers motivated by private health returns. We test this prediction through a randomized controlled trial in Kenya through which members of existing farmer groups were offered an opportunity to purchase a food safety input, and half were offered a 5% market premium for produce that met the associated regulatory standard. Access to the premium more than doubled investment in the food safety technology. In line with the model's prediction, most premium‐induced adoption was by farmers motivated by a combination of health and financial rewards.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了适度的食品安全溢价对半自给农民投资食品安全技术的影响。我们从理论上证明，在生产不确定性的情况下，低于实现安全标准边际生产成本的市场激励可以增加受私人健康回报驱动的农民对食品安全的投资。我们通过在肯尼亚进行的一项随机对照试验来检验这一预测，该试验中，现有农民团体的成员有机会购买一种食品安全投入品，其中一半人获得了符合相关监管标准的产品5%的市场溢价。获得溢价使食品安全技术的投资增加了一倍以上。与该模型的预测一致，大多数溢价诱导的采用是由健康和财务回报共同驱动的农民所为。

articles.title_en: Impacts of forest conservation on local agricultural labor supply: Evidence from the Indonesian forest moratorium
articles.title_cn: 森林保护对当地农业劳动力供给的影响：来自印度尼西亚森林暂停令的证据
articles.abstract_en: Tropical forest conservation is critical for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and maintaining global ecosystems. Understanding the channels through which conservation affects agricultural activities and livelihoods in these regions is key to designing effective policies and promoting sustainable development. To this end, we use labor supply data from Indonesia in 2007 and 2015 combined with a matching strategy to estimate the impacts of a national forest conservation policy, the forest moratorium, on local agricultural labor. Consistent with the predictions of our theoretical model, we find robust empirical evidence that the moratorium increased local agricultural employment and slowed structural transformation away from the agricultural sector. We provide corresponding evidence of decreased household expenditure due to the moratorium. Despite the moratorium, we find significant deforestation and forest degradation within the boundaries of the moratorium‐targeted areas, suggesting that increases in local agricultural employment may partly dampen the conservation policy's effectiveness. Our work offers new insights into evaluating existing conservation policies and designing future policies for Indonesia and other resource‐dependent economies that face similar challenges in balancing economic growth with conservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 热带森林保护对于减少温室气体排放和维护全球生态系统至关重要。了解保护措施影响这些地区农业活动和生计的渠道，是设计有效政策和促进可持续发展的关键。为此，我们利用印度尼西亚2007年和2015年的劳动力供给数据，结合匹配策略，评估了一项国家森林保护政策——森林暂停令——对当地农业劳动力的影响。与我们的理论模型预测一致，我们发现了强有力的实证证据表明，暂停令增加了当地农业就业，并减缓了农业部门的结构转型。我们提供了相应的证据，表明暂停令导致家庭支出减少。尽管有暂停令，我们发现在暂停令目标区域内存在显著的森林砍伐和森林退化，这表明当地农业就业的增加可能部分削弱了保护政策的有效性。我们的工作为评估现有保护政策和设计未来政策提供了新的见解，这些政策适用于印度尼西亚和其他依赖资源的经济体，它们面临着平衡经济增长与保护的类似挑战。

articles.title_en: Farm support and market distortion: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 农业支持与市场扭曲：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies market distortions due to farm support policies. Using a recently implemented Price Deficiency Payments (PDP) policy in India, we examine how PDP affects farm‐gate prices and crop supply. We document a new channel, the fall in reservation price of farmers under PDP, behind the decline in farm‐gate prices. This impact depends on the magnitude of the deficiency payments and can lead to a supply glut and price crash. Empirically, the scheme led to a 4% decrease in farm‐gate prices and a 51% increase in market arrivals for black‐gram, a crop with a high magnitude of PDP. Using bid‐level data on crop auctions, we rule out collusion among the market participants, another potential channel for price crash under PDP. The effects of the policy are transitory and disappear after the policy is withdrawn. In terms of welfare effects, this scheme is associated with a monetary loss of INR 1 billion. We discuss an alternate payment scheme that can reduce such losses. In summary, our results extend the current understanding of PDP schemes and contribute to the optimal design of such policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了农业支持政策导致的市场扭曲。利用印度最近实施的价格缺口补偿（PDP）政策，我们考察了PDP如何影响农场门口价格和作物供给。我们记录了一个新渠道，即PDP下农民保留价格的下降，这是农场门口价格下跌背后的原因。这种影响取决于补偿金额的大小，并可能导致供应过剩和价格崩溃。实证上，该政策导致黑吉豆（一种PDP金额较高的作物）的农场门口价格下降了4%，市场到货量增加了51%。利用作物拍卖的出价层面数据，我们排除了市场参与者之间的共谋，这是PDP下价格崩溃的另一个潜在渠道。该政策的影响是暂时的，在政策撤销后消失。在福利效应方面，该计划与1亿印度卢比的货币损失相关。我们讨论了一种可以减少此类损失的替代支付方案。总之，我们的结果扩展了当前对PDP计划的理解，并有助于此类政策的最优设计。

articles.title_en: Incentivizing and nudging farmers to spread information: Experimental evidence from Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 激励与助推农民传播信息：来自埃塞俄比亚的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Information does not flow freely through social networks. We use an experiment to study knowledge diffusion about an innovation (integrated pest management, IPM) in farmer groups in Ethiopia. Group leaders are incentivized to share knowledge with members through the conditional provision of material or social prestige rewards. We combine incentives with loss‐framed messaging to leverage loss aversion. Incentives increase diffusion effort, and combining incentives with loss‐framed messaging increases effort further. However, the treatments failed to induce follower farmers to experiment with IPM. We also document that reclaiming material rewards is difficult after a long delay, attenuating the effectiveness of the loss frame.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息不会在社会网络中自由流动。我们通过一项实验研究埃塞俄比亚农民群体中关于一项创新（综合害虫管理，IPM）的知识扩散。群体领导者通过有条件地提供物质或社会声望奖励来激励其与成员分享知识。我们将激励与损失框架信息相结合，以利用损失厌恶。激励增加了扩散努力，而将激励与损失框架信息相结合则进一步增加了努力。然而，这些处理未能诱导追随农民尝试IPM。我们还记录了在长时间延迟后收回物质奖励的困难，这削弱了损失框架的有效性。

articles.title_en: Getting the message out: Information and communication technologies and agricultural extension
articles.title_cn: 传递信息：信息通信技术与农业推广
articles.abstract_en: There has been much optimism about the potential of information and communication technologies (ICTs) to provide agricultural extension services to remote households. Yet, little is known about how different communication methods fare, and, moreover, whether different segments of the population adopt information communicated via different means equally. We conduct a randomized controlled trial comparing the effectiveness of three ICTs—radio, voice response messages, and a smartphone app—with traditional extension training in communicating fertilizer management practices across four districts in rural Nepal. We find that farmers in the smartphone app and the extension training programs are on average 8.4 and 13 percentage points more likely to adopt top dressing fertilizer practices compared to control farmers, statistically significant at the 1% and 5% levels, respectively. Farmers in the smartphone app treatment achieve the highest agronomic literacy test scores, 7.8 percentage points higher than the control, statistically significant at the 1% level. In contrast, farmers receiving radio or voice response messages were not more likely to adopt the same fertilizer recommendations nor show improved specific or general agronomic knowledge relative to control farmers. Our results suggest that smartphone apps are more cost effective at inducing farmer knowledge and technology adoption than extension trainings. Heterogeneous treatment effects, however, reveal that a targeted ICT approach may be more effective in disseminating extension advice.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于信息通信技术（ICTs）在向偏远农户提供农业推广服务方面的潜力，人们一直抱有极大的乐观态度。然而，关于不同通信方式的效果如何，以及不同人群是否平等地采纳通过不同方式传播的信息，我们知之甚少。我们进行了一项随机对照试验，比较了三种信息通信技术——广播、语音应答消息和智能手机应用程序——与传统推广培训在尼泊尔农村四个地区传播肥料管理实践方面的有效性。我们发现，与对照组农户相比，智能手机应用程序组和推广培训组的农户采用追肥实践的可能性平均高出8.4和13个百分点，分别在1%和5%的水平上统计显著。智能手机应用程序处理组的农户在农艺素养测试中得分最高，比对照组高出7.8个百分点，在1%的水平上统计显著。相比之下，接受广播或语音应答消息的农户在采用相同的肥料建议方面没有更可能，也没有表现出相对于对照组农户在特定或一般农艺知识方面的改善。我们的结果表明，在诱导农户知识和采用技术方面，智能手机应用程序比推广培训更具成本效益。然而，异质性处理效应揭示，有针对性的信息通信技术方法可能在传播推广建议方面更有效。
